_milestone: First successful end-to-end bridge<->LEAN integration. All 35 data requests succeeded; zero bridge errors.

lean_run_summary.result_finalizer_warning: BacktestingResultHandler.SendFinalResult InvalidOperationException 'Sequence contains no elements' — LEAN couldn't produce a summary.json because the algorithm placed no orders and produced no equity samples beyond the initial point. Not a bridge failure.

_remaining_issue: Algorithm: OnData gates on `if self.gex_symbol not in slice: return`. For LEAN Daily resolution, the equity slice and custom-data slice arrive separately (different timestamps), so the gate short-circuits on every slice that contains only SPY equity. The 35 GexBar data requests succeeded at the bridge layer but LEAN only delivered 2 'data point' slices to OnData — likely because most GexBars came back empty (sparse data) and LEAN skipped them per the new graceful-skip behavior.
_root_cause_of_zero_trades: Possibility 1: Most calendar days within 2024-06-03 to 2024-07-05 are NON-trading days or fall on weekends/holidays — for Daily resolution, LEAN ticks midnight UTC every day, even non-trading days. Our bridge returns empty for those (correct sparse handling), so most slices have no GexBar.

Possibility 2: Even on trading days, midnight UTC has no GEX data (the API only has data at market hours). So our v0.1.4+ 'empty file' fallback was triggered, LEAN skipped the bar, and the algorithm never received a usable GexBar.

Possibility 3: Time-of-bar alignment — LEAN expects daily-res bars to be timestamped at midnight UTC; we set Time=date (the passed midnight) and EndTime=date+1day. Slice routing may not match SPY equity bars (which tick at session close).
_bridge_bugs_caught_by_v8_journey: Bug 4 (v0.1.1 -> v0.1.2): SubscriptionDataSource imported from QuantConnect (should be QuantConnect.Data)
Bug 5 (v0.1.2 -> v0.1.3): SubscriptionTransportMedium imported from QuantConnect.Data (should be QuantConnect)
Bug 6 (smoke template workaround): bridge config.resolve_api_key() never reads QC parameters in practice — wired via self.GetParameter() -> config.api_key in Initialize
Bug 7 (v0.1.3 -> v0.1.4): NoDataError/NoCoverageError/InvalidAtError propagated unchanged, aborted the entire subscription. Now caught and treated as 'skip this bar'.

Bug 8 (v0.1.4 -> v0.1.5): SubscriptionTransportMedium.Rest with custom 'flashalpha://' scheme not supported by LEAN's RestSubscriptionStreamReader. Now writes JSON to a temp file under OS tempdir + uses LocalFile transport.
